originStory.title: Why I Bundled These Two
originStory.subtitle: The two gaps I've seen hold back hundreds of developers
originStory.story:
After 30+ years in software, I've noticed a pattern. Junior developers get stuck for two reasons.

First: they code, but they don't think like professionals. They haven't developed the mindset, habits, and approach that turns coding ability into career growth.

Second: they build things, but they don't understand clients. They create technically solid features that nobody uses because they never learned to figure out what users actually need.

Here's the thing: these two gaps are connected. Professional developers know their job isn't to write code. It's to solve problems for real people. That takes both the right mindset AND the ability to understand what clients truly need.

I created this bundle because fixing one gap without the other leaves you stuck. You need both foundations.
originStory.inspirationPoint: Fixing one gap without the other leaves you stuck
